attempts.plan: I will replace the `double`-based logic with `long` arithmetic to store all balances as total cents. This eliminates floating-point precision issues and ensures exact rounding for interest and fair distribution of split payments.

The `MoneyUtil` parser is overly restrictive, forcing two-decimal input and incorrectly failing on integers, while the interest calculation uses incorrect precision by converting cents to decimals before division. I will update `MoneyUtil` to use `BigDecimal` for parsing to support flexible input formats and fix `InterestCalculator` to correctly perform fixed-point calculation.

The golden test `splitIsValidated` expects the balance to remain unchanged when a split fails, but the implementation was deducting the payment from the source account before validating the payee list. I will refactor `splitPayment` to perform all validations before modifying any account balances.
